children: 0125 GMT - Asian currencies broadly weaken against the dollar ahead of U.S. nonfarm payrolls report due later today. "Continued U.S. labour-market resilience would reinforce higher-for-longer U.S. rates, keeping U.S. yields and the USD supported, limiting the benefit from stronger Asian macro data," MUFG Bank's senior currency analyst Lloyd Chan says in a research report. The U.S. dollar rises 0.3% to 1,362.56 won and is 0.1% higher at 1.2814 Singapore dollars, while the Australian dollar is down 0.2% at US$0.6917, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)

0125 GMT - Asian currencies broadly weaken against the dollar ahead of U.S. nonfarm payrolls report due later today. "Continued U.S. labour-market resilience would reinforce higher-for-longer U.S. rates, keeping U.S. yields and the USD supported, limiting the benefit from stronger Asian macro data," MUFG Bank's senior currency analyst Lloyd Chan says in a research report. The U.S. dollar rises 0.3% to 1,362.56 won and is 0.1% higher at 1.2814 Singapore dollars, while the Australian dollar is down 0.2% at US$0.6917, LSEG data show. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
